seo_section_1_title: All the PDF Tools You Need — 100% Free
seo_section_1_text: e-pdf.bg gives you a complete set of free online PDF tools for every document task. Merge multiple files into one, split or extract specific pages, compress large PDFs without losing quality, and convert between PDF and popular formats like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, and PNG — all directly in your browser. No software to install, no account required.
seo_section_2_title: Convert PDF Files to Any Format
seo_section_2_text: Our conversion tools handle the full range of PDF workflows. Export PDFs as editable Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, or PowerPoint presentations. Convert JPG, PNG, BMP, and TIFF images to PDF and back. Every conversion preserves the original layout and quality of your documents so the result looks exactly as expected.
seo_section_3_text: Privacy is built into every tool on e-pdf.bg. All uploaded files are processed on our servers and automatically and permanently deleted within one hour. We never store, read, or share your documents with anyone. You can also add password protection to your PDF files or remove existing passwords with our PDF security tools.
